name: – Jaroslav Bžoch – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement between the European Union and the Swiss Confederation on the transfer of Passenger Name Record (PNR) data for the prevention, detection, investigation and prosecution of terrorist offences and serious crime
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a new deal between the European Union and Switzerland on sharing airline passenger data. Airlines flying between the two will be able to pass booking details to Swiss police, and Swiss airlines will send data to European Union countries. This helps both sides fight terrorism and serious crime such as drug, weapons and people trafficking. The deal includes strict rules to protect passengers' personal data, and the European Data Protection Supervisor found these safeguards satisfactory.

- Airlines can now send passenger booking data between the European Union and Switzerland for security purposes.
- It affects air passengers on those flights and police forces fighting terrorism and serious crime.
- Parliament has given its consent, so the agreement can now be formally concluded and come into force.
